mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals stronger labor market conditions, boosting equity valuations and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces negative 20d returns despite UNRATE declining below 5.0% in the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) above 19,000 Billions of Chained 2017 Dollars signals robust economic growth, driving up equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 19,000 in an expanding economy.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in both GDP (demand) and Industrial Production (supply) indicates a balanced or expanding economy, strengthening market confidence and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 and INDPRO rise simultaneously in an expanding economy.

mechanism_narrative: In a tightening monetary cycle, a sustained increase in the federal funds rate signals higher interest rates, compressing discount rates and reducing future equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 produces positive 5-day returns despite FEDFUNDS rising in a tightening monetary cycle.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in Industrial Production (INDPRO) above 107.2 indicates robust manufacturing activity, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO rises above 107.2 in an expanding supply chain.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.5% signals a tight labor market, reducing wage growth pressures and boosting corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when UNRATE falls below 4.5% in a tight labor market.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in GDP (demand) and a decline in unemployment (labor) indicates robust economic activity, strengthening market sentiment and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when both GDPC1 rises and UNRATE falls in an expanding economy.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in the federal funds rate below 3.0% signals central bank confidence in economic growth, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS drops below 3.0% in a late-cycle expansion.
